title: Small Concrete Pump for Floor Screed and Concrete Slab Construction
seoTitle: Small Concrete Pump for Floor Screed and Slab Construction | Pinjin
description: Select a small concrete pump for floor screed and slab work from Xingtai catalogue output, aggregate and distance. Electric 15, Electric 20, Electric 30 and Low Pressure 40 are compared only on published rows — not invented screed thicknesses.

answerBlock.what: A small concrete pump for floor screed and slab work is a compact or mid trailer whose catalogue output, stone and pipe match the floor pour. Pinjin rows used here: Electric 15 (8–10 m³/h, 1–3 cm), Electric 20 (8–10 m³/h, 1–2 cm), Electric 30 and Low Pressure 40 (12–15 m³/h, fine-stone distance pairs). We do not publish screed millimetres.
answerBlock.who: Contractors placing floor screeds, small slabs and indoor pipeline floors on sites with three-phase power, who can state stone size and pipe run.
factors: Mix: fine-stone versus 1–2 cm versus 1–3 cm against the printed max aggregate
Output band: 8–10 m³/h compact versus 12–15 m³/h Electric 30 / LP40
Fine-stone metres on Electric 30 (60/180) versus LP40 (80/240)
Trailer weight for indoor or courtyard access

faqs.question: What screed thickness does Pinjin recommend?
faqs.answer: We do not publish thickness or floor-heating pipe cover. Those are design figures. We only match stone, output and pipe to a catalogue pump row.

faqs.question: Is a small concrete pump the same as a plaster sprayer?
faqs.answer: No. Sprayers list particle ≤8 mm or ≤4 mm. Floor screed with stone is a trailer pump job. See the fine-stone versus mortar sprayer page.
